summary: Ship a Copilot code-review skill for PLATE PR checks (#1092, Epic #1091).
migration_impact: Downstream repos that adopt or refresh template payload receive `.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` for GitHub Copilot code review on PLATE pull requests.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core or re-run `gh plate import-payload` / bootstrap adopt when this release ships.
2. Ensure `.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` exists on integration branches so Copilot review on PRs can load it from the head branch.
3. No `.plate` changes are required for this skill alone.
agent_notes: Copilot code review loads skills from `.github/skills/` on the PR head branch; the `code-review` directory name improves discovery. Use the checklist for Feature/Bug/Documentation PRs: issue link, fragment location, labels, procutil subprocesses, unittest not pytest, and accurate claims.
